messages:
auditor_lee: Can you provide RBAC change evidence + KMS rotation history for the infra account. We need a signed bundle and a short recorded walkthrough (demo) showing how role grant maps to API access. Sampling: past 30 days.

nina (Security): noted. Do you want the full CloudTrail events or just the KMS and auth indices? Also do you accept screenshots of the HSM attestation?

auditor_lee: KMS + auth indices are fine. PDF attestation preferred but screenshots ok as interim. Signed manifest required.

sam (Infra): I'll gather role.change events from auth-index, apigw traces, and kms-audit. Will use our evidence-exporter to produce a redacted tar.gz and sign with compliance key. Example commands I'll use: ```
./evidence-exporter --indexes auth-index,apigw,kms-audit --filter "_time>=now-30d AND account=infra" --redact redact.json --out /tmp/infra_rbac_bundle.tar.gz
cosign sign-blob --key /opt/keys/compliance.key /tmp/infra_rbac_bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/infra_rbac_bundle.tar.gz > /tmp/infra_rbac_bundle.sha256
```

evidence-bot: Export scheduled. All bundles will be logged to compliance-audit index and retained for 90 days.

nina (Security): For correlation we'll include a small script that links role.change event ids to KMS GenerateDataKey events and apigw request_ids. Also will add a README with exact Splunk queries and signing fingerprint.

auditor_lee: Please include the key creation event and any rotation timestamps. Also include the KMS key alias and the key ID.

sam (Infra): Copy. I'll maintain the raw request_ids and timestamps; redact PII. ETA EOD tomorrow for upload.

auditor_lee: thanks, looking forward to the bundle and demo link.
